Introducing Open Stacks Sponsor Relay (OSSR).

Send sBTC on Stacks without first acquiring STX. You sign the transfer; a relay pays the STX network fee and receives reimbursement in sats, atomically in the same transaction.

Our open-source testnet prototype demonstrates sponsored sBTC transfers with a zero-STX user. We're building toward an open network of independent operators.

Explore the code, run a relay, or help integrate a wallet:
https://github.com/ossr-protocol/ossr

Documentation: https://github.com/ossr-protocol/ossr#readme

Testnet proof of concept; not a mainnet release.
